connector.name: Eansearch MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for real-time product search by barcode (EAN, UPC, GTIN) or keyword on ean-search.org
connector.summary: Hosted at ean-search.org over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package eansearch-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the eansearch account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
